content:
alex: Quick thread — drafting the run-of-show & demo fallback for the 'Interactive Inference' webinar. Need a producer checklist.

maria: Love it. Primary ask: what happens if demo model spikes latency? Do we have a safe fallback model or prerecorded clip?

sam: We should route live Qs to the backup model + have a plug-and-play screen-share recording as last resort. Short script below.

sam: ```
# Run-of-show snippet
00:00 - Intro (host)
04:00 - Product overview (host)
08:00 - Live demo (host + eng)
08:30 - If latency > 1.2s/token -> switch to model 'redwood-lite-v1' and enable prefix cache
09:00 - If fallback fails -> play canned 2m demo video (pre-recorded)
12:00 - Q&A (moderator routes questions)
```

jonah: For incoming questions, set up a routing form that tags leads by intent (prod/integration/enterprise). Engineering questions go to #eng-oncall, product questions to #sales, press/promo to marketing ops.

tia: I'll produce the canned clip (2m) and a one-slide visual showing "why fallback" for transparency. Also drafting speaker cues.

ops-bot: Reminder: reserve rehearsal GPU slot. Use /reserve-gpu dedicated-1 2h. Failure to reserve will block effective latency testing.

alex: Confirmed reservation. Rehearsal Mon 10:00am PT — @maria @sam @tia please join.

maria: I'll be there and will bring 3 edge-case prompts (long context, many tokens, structured output).

sam: I'll bring a live latency dashboard link and a shortened transcript for panel notes.

alex: Final action items: tia -> canned video, sam -> dashboard + switch script, jonah -> routing form & lead tags, maria -> test prompts. Checkpoint Friday 11:00am PT.

maria: Sounds good. I'll add the prompts to the shared drive and tag ppl. :thumbsup:
